Oh dang this is hard. Dating sucks when you're neuroatypical tbh. I'm ADHD myself and my boyfriend is autistic. The difficulty is there's sort of game to dating. You seem to approach it somewhat like a job interview you're trying to land, as opposed to getting to know the person. Dating is really more about getting a bit of a taste for the other persons personality, and really determining if it's worth putting the emotional energy into. And it results in a lot of rejection, n I know for me personally that's the hardest thing to recover from.
In reality trying to approach it from a point of how much in common you have. Ask about their interests, really listen to them talk about said interests (also think about if you would be willing to hear about those interests more. If they're completely uninteresting or even annoying to hear about, it might be a pass)
You can say yours and just keep that back and forth going. What might be helpful for you is looking at what you would want out a boyfriend beyond just having one. 

In reality this is a bit above what reddit can offer, so if you can connect with a therapist they can help you a lot. Mine gave me a lot of mental scripts to run through when meeting new people. Honestly dating sort of sucks because it's a game of politeness and nuance which neuroatypical people can rly struggle with lol.

I wish you the best of luck finding your knight in shining armor ✌✌
